decision: Qualify TQP-52 through TQP-54 in dependency order for the pinned Windows CPU production candidate and integration migration while leaving TQP-55 and every later release claim fail-closed.

TQP-53 retains production editor authoring preview diagnostics profile import/export repro export and native weighted-material behavior without a lab runtime dependency

world-transvoxel commit f4abd7ab4f921f98aba4ee45b4453af0bae53cd8 remains the sole native terrain authority
qualified_scope: TQP-52 candidate CPU runtime API profile readiness back-pressure and cancellation contract
TQP-53 bounded production authoring inspection repro and weighted-material workflow
TQP-54 exact downstream package migration render collision edit persistence replay and fail-closed behavior

unqualified_scope: the terminated deep flat-baseline timeout attempt
non-Windows GPU gameplay and networking claims

review: The promotion is evidence-bounded. The lab validates pinned external artifacts and does not load the production addon, reinterpret screenshots as correctness proof, treat power intent as measured performance, or infer release readiness from migration success.
downstream_impact: The standalone CPU wave now has a qualified candidate runtime, authoring workflow, and pinned integration migration. The next work is the TQP-55 release matrix; long-haul certification and release remain blocked.
